messages:
Samira Patel: Hi team 👋 I’m Samira, started today in infra. Quick q: I got my laptop but can’t access the internal wiki or push to git. Also where do I request stickers? Fun fact: I build mechanical keyboards and I bake sourdough.
Lena (People Ops): Welcome Samira!! :tada: Mind DMing me your shipping address for swag? Wiki and accounts should be set up; sometimes Okta needs a manual activation. I’ll ping IT.
devops-bot: Account created: samira.patel. Please finish SSO setup: https://okta.example.com/setup.
Samira Patel: thx! Okta link works now. Still hitting permission denied on git push though.
Joel Park: Hey Samira — welcome! For SSH try adding your key to the ops team:
```
ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -C "samira@redwood"
cat ~/.ssh/id_ed25519.pub | pbcopy  # paste into ID doc
```
Then ping me and I’ll add you to repo perms.
Samira Patel: copying keys now. one sec.
Max Rivera: hey Samira — team lunch tomorrow at 12 if you want to join (Taco truck :taco:). Also #infra-watercooler is where we share stickers and keycap pics.
Ricky: I’m your onboarding buddy — ping me for anything infra-y, can do a 30m walkthrough today.
Samira Patel: Amazing, thanks everyone! I’ll DM Lena address and ping Joel/Ricky after I finish the key setup. Excited to be here :)
